text.tspan: Where the labs run: small networks inside one Linux container
Docker Desktop's Linux VM: --privileged applies here, not to macOS
--privileged: never on a shared or production Linux server
Each lab creates its own namespaces and deletes them in cleanup.
Exiting the container (--rm) throws everything away.
then run lab commands with sudo
billed by the hour, plus storage
free tier depends on your account
stop or terminate it when done
security group: your own IP only
a separate computer: its own interfaces,
a virtual cable between two namespaces
